question: Kamalini Asthana and Nalini Asthana, veteran dancers who represent Benaras Gharana of Kathak, were conferred with which of the following awards in the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamalini Asthana and Nalini Asthana** are veteran dancers who represent the **Benaras Gharana of Kathak**.
 
• They were conferred with the **Padma Shri** award in the year 2022.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished contributions in various fields including the arts.
 
• The award acknowledges their significant contributions to the preservation and promotion of Kathak dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Awards** are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• They are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (for distinguished service of high order), and **Padma Shri** (for distinguished service).
 
• The awards are aimed at recognizing achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved.
 
• Other recipients of the Padma Shri award in the field of arts in 2022 include notable personalities from various artistic disciplines.
